spec.title: Disks with Failure Precursors
spec.description: Disks reporting any reallocated, pending, offline-uncorrectable or reported-uncorrectable sectors. A nonzero count is not an outage: it means those disks have remapped or failed to read sectors at some point. Growth is what matters, and is alerted separately.

spec.expr: (count(max by (instance, disk) (smartmon_reallocated_sector_ct_raw_value{instance=~"$instance"} or smartmon_current_pending_sector_raw_value{instance=~"$instance"} or smartmon_offline_uncorrectable_raw_value{instance=~"$instance"} or smartmon_reported_uncorrect_raw_value{instance=~"$instance"}) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(max by (instance, device) (smartctl_device_attribute{job="scrapeConfig/monitoring/smartctl-exporter-external",attribute_value_type="raw",attribute_name=~"Reallocated_Sector_Ct|Current_Pending_Sector|Offline_Uncorrectable|Reported_Uncorrect"}) > 0) or vector(0))
